contact.intro: Choose whichever is easiest for you — straight to the parish office's e-mail, or a message on WhatsApp.

error.title: Something got stuck on our end
error.body1: The fault is on our side, not yours — the candle flickered for a moment. Trying again is usually enough.
error.body2: If it keeps happening, let the parish office know and we'll pass it on to whoever keeps this running.

notFound.title: There's no page at this address
notFound.body1: Looks like you've strayed off the path a little — it happens to the best pilgrims. The link is probably outdated, or the page has since moved.
notFound.body2: Head back to the homepage, or see what's new in the parish.
